verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own background automation. Ramp agents scan transactions in real time and approve when it's safe. Rules-based workflows route requests automatically. Ramp rebooks hotels when prices drop. Its agent platform also offers long-running access for background agents that run on a schedule. However, the scheduled agents themselves must be built and run by the user via the CLI or API, and the docs state that no money moves without human confirmation. missing for 10: a documented first-party builder for user-defined recurring automations, in-product scheduling of custom tasks, independent hands-on corroboration of autonomous background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
